note: Record box (唱片盒) shown beside the reading for each language. kind: song | podcast | film. Descriptions en/zh/de/pt. Links are search links (YouTube/Spotify) unless a stable page is known.

pt.title: Apesar de você
pt.en: Sounds like a song to a lover, but it was aimed at the dictatorship — and was banned. Slow and clear: a good first song.
pt.zh: 表面是情歌，其实是骂独裁者，后来被禁。节奏慢、发音清楚，适合当第一首。
pt.de: Klingt wie ein Liebeslied, meint aber die Diktatur – und wurde verboten. Langsam und deutlich gesungen.
pt.pt: Parece uma canção de amor, mas fala da ditadura – e foi censurada.

pt.title: Pra não dizer que não falei das flores
pt.en: The anthem of resistance against the military regime. Simple melody, lots of repetition — easy to sing along at A1.
pt.zh: 反独裁运动的「国歌」。旋律简单、重复多，A1 也能跟着唱。
pt.de: Die Hymne des Widerstands gegen die Militärdiktatur. Einfache Melodie, viele Wiederholungen.
pt.pt: O hino da resistência contra a ditadura. Melodia simples, fácil de cantar.

pt.title: O bêbado e a equilibrista
pt.en: Written by João Bosco and Aldir Blanc; it became the song of the campaign for amnesty for political prisoners. Elis's diction is a model for pronunciation.
pt.zh: João Bosco 和 Aldir Blanc 写的歌，后来成了争取政治犯大赦运动的歌。Elis 的咬字是学发音的好榜样。
pt.de: Von João Bosco und Aldir Blanc; wurde zum Lied der Amnestie-Bewegung. Elis' Aussprache ist ein Vorbild.
pt.pt: De João Bosco e Aldir Blanc; virou a canção da luta pela anistia.

pt.title: Cálice
pt.en: "Cálice" (chalice) sounds like "cale-se" (shut up): the whole song is a play on censorship. Listen first; read the lyrics later at B1.
pt.zh: 「Cálice」（圣杯）听起来像「Cale-se」（闭嘴），整首歌都在讽刺审查。先听，歌词等 B1 再细读。
pt.de: „Cálice“ (Kelch) klingt wie „cale-se“ (sei still): ein Lied über die Zensur.
pt.pt: "Cálice" soa como "cale-se": uma canção sobre a censura.

pt.title: Construção
pt.en: One day in the life — and death — of a construction worker; famous for its word play. A goal for B1–B2.
pt.zh: 一个建筑工人的一天和他的死，文字游戏非常有名。B1–B2 的目标。
pt.de: Ein Tag im Leben – und Sterben – eines Bauarbeiters; berühmt für sein Wortspiel. Ein Ziel für B1–B2.
pt.pt: Um dia na vida de um operário da construção. Para o nível B1–B2.

pt.title: Gilberto Gil — canções
pt.en: Arrested and exiled to London in 1969 with Caetano Veloso, later Brazil's minister of culture. Light rhythms, short lines: start with "Aquele abraço".
pt.zh: 1969 年和 Caetano Veloso 一起被捕、流亡伦敦，后来当过巴西文化部长。节奏轻快、句子短，从「Aquele abraço」开始。
pt.de: 1969 mit Caetano Veloso verhaftet und nach London verbannt, später Kulturminister. Leichte Rhythmen – zum Einstieg „Aquele abraço“.
pt.pt: Preso e exilado em 1969; depois ministro da Cultura. Comece com "Aquele abraço".

pt.title: A Carne
pt.en: A landmark of Brazilian anti-racism: a song about how Black lives are treated in Brazil. Her late album "A Mulher do Fim do Mundo" is also great.
pt.zh: 巴西反种族主义的标志性歌曲，唱的是黑人在巴西社会的遭遇。她晚年的专辑《A Mulher do Fim do Mundo》也很好。
pt.de: Ein Meilenstein des brasilianischen Antirassismus. Auch ihr spätes Album „A Mulher do Fim do Mundo“ lohnt sich.
pt.pt: Um marco do antirracismo no Brasil. Ouça também "A Mulher do Fim do Mundo".

pt.title: AmarElo – É Tudo Pra Ontem
pt.en: São Paulo rapper Emicida's album AmarElo (2019) and the Netflix documentary about it, a history of Black culture in Brazil — with subtitles.
pt.zh: 圣保罗说唱歌手 Emicida 的专辑《AmarElo》（2019）和 Netflix 纪录片，讲巴西黑人文化史，有字幕，强烈推荐。
pt.de: Emicidas Album AmarElo (2019) und die Netflix-Doku dazu – eine Geschichte schwarzer Kultur in Brasilien, mit Untertiteln.
pt.pt: O álbum AmarElo e o documentário da Netflix sobre a cultura negra no Brasil.

pt.title: Sobrevivendo no Inferno
pt.en: The legendary album from São Paulo's periphery, later put on Unicamp's required reading list. Fast and full of slang: save it for B1+.
pt.zh: 圣保罗边缘社区的传奇专辑，后来被列进 Unicamp 的入学必读书单。语速快、俚语多，留到 B1 以后。
pt.de: Das legendäre Album aus São Paulos Peripherie, später Pflichtlektüre an der Unicamp. Schnell und voller Slang – ab B1.
pt.pt: O álbum lendário da periferia de São Paulo. Para depois do B1.

pt.title: Cota não é esmola
pt.en: A direct, powerful song about racial quotas at Brazilian universities.
pt.zh: 关于大学种族配额的歌，非常直接、有力量。
pt.de: Ein direktes, kraftvolles Lied über Quoten an brasilianischen Universitäten.
pt.pt: Uma canção direta sobre cotas raciais nas universidades.

pt.title: Carioca Connection
pt.en: Two Cariocas talk about everyday Brazilian life at normal speed, with slang; transcripts on their website. Start with a few minutes plus the transcript.
pt.zh: 两个里约人用正常语速聊巴西日常，有俚语，网站上有文字稿。先听几分钟，配着文字稿。
pt.de: Zwei Cariocas sprechen in normalem Tempo über den brasilianischen Alltag, mit Slang; Transkripte auf der Website.
pt.pt: Dois cariocas falam do dia a dia no Brasil, com gírias e transcrições.

pt.title: Portuguese With Carla
pt.en: Brazilian Portuguese for intermediate learners, with downloadable transcripts and word lists.
pt.zh: 给中级学习者的巴西葡语播客，每集有可下载的文字稿和词汇表。
pt.de: Brasilianisches Portugiesisch für Mittelstufe, mit Transkripten und Wortlisten.
pt.pt: Português do Brasil para nível intermediário, com transcrições.

pt.title: Fala Gringo
pt.en: Brazilian hosts chat about music, routines and travel, mostly in Portuguese with some English help.
pt.zh: 巴西主持人聊音乐、日常和旅行，主要说葡语，偶尔用英语解释。
pt.de: Brasilianische Hosts plaudern über Musik, Alltag und Reisen, meist auf Portugiesisch.
pt.pt: Conversas sobre música, rotina e viagens.

pt.title: Medo e Delírio em Brasília
pt.en: Satirical, left-leaning politics podcast, twice a week for seven years. Fast and full of jokes — a goal for B2.
pt.zh: 讽刺、偏左的政治播客，一周约两更，已经做了七年。语速快、梗多，是 B2 的目标。
pt.de: Satirischer, linker Politik-Podcast, seit sieben Jahren etwa zweimal pro Woche. Schnell und voller Witz – ein Ziel für B2.
pt.pt: Podcast satírico de política. Para o nível B2.

pt.title: Mamilos
pt.en: Progressive debates on social issues and culture, often with experts. Advanced.
pt.zh: 进步派的社会议题和文化讨论，常请专家。高级。
pt.de: Progressive Debatten über Gesellschaft und Kultur, oft mit Fachleuten. Fortgeschritten.
pt.pt: Debates progressistas sobre sociedade e cultura.

pt.title: Anticast
pt.en: Long left-leaning conversations on politics, culture and current events, with rich vocabulary. Advanced.
pt.zh: 一小时以上的政治、文化讨论，偏左，词汇高级。
pt.de: Lange, linke Gespräche über Politik, Kultur und Aktuelles. Fortgeschritten.
pt.pt: Conversas longas sobre política e cultura.
